name: Deuruxolitinib
description: Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor taken by mouth, a small molecule developed as CTP-543

note.text: Alopecia areata is an autoimmune disease. Leqselvi is not approved for male pattern hair loss or for people under 18.

bullets: **JAKs** pass on signals from cytokines and growth factors for immune function
**In lab tests,** it blocked JAK1, JAK2 and TYK2 more strongly than JAK3
**How this relates** to its effect on hair is not known, per the label

practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak within 1.5 hours; liver metabolism (CYP2C9, CYP3A4)
practical.monitored: CYP2C9 genotype before use; blood counts, blood fats

regulatory.text: Boxed warning: infections, cancer, heart, clots

references: King et al., J Am Acad Dermatol, THRIVE-AA1, Nov 2024
Tsianakas et al., J Am Acad Dermatol, THRIVE-AA2, Apr 2026
